What Goes Into a Secured Door

Anatomy of an Access-Controlled Opening

  1. 1
    Reader. Card, phone, PIN or biometric. OSDP secure readers encrypt the wiring back to the controller.
  2. 2
    Request-to-exit sensor. Lets people leave freely without triggering a forced-door alarm.
  3. 3
    Door position switch. Reports doors forced open or propped open.
  4. 4
    Electrified hardware. Strike, maglock or electrified lever, fail-safe or fail-secure as code requires.
  5. 5
    Controller. Makes the grant or deny decision, even if the network is down.
  6. 6
    Power supply. Supervised, with battery backup for the locks and readers.
  7. 7
    Management software. Badges, schedules, reports and lockdown, on-site or hosted.
  8. 8
    Fire alarm interface. Releases locks on the egress path. Because we also design fire alarm systems, one team coordinates it.

However Your People Want to Get In

Proximity & Smart Cards

Keep existing cards during an upgrade, or move to encrypted smart cards.

Mobile Credentials

Biometrics
